articleBody:
Getting a new roof is a big step, and a little preparation on your end can make the whole installation process smoother and less stressful for everyone. Your roof protects your home, and making sure the project goes off without a hitch helps ensure that protection is solid from day one.

Here's a handy checklist to help you get ready for your new roof:

- [ ] Clear the perimeter around your house — why: This gives our crew safe and clear access to your roof and helps prevent damage to your landscaping or personal items. Move outdoor furniture, grills, potted plants, and decorations at least 15 feet away from the house.
- [ ] Trim low-hanging branches — why: If there are branches touching or hanging over your roof, trimming them back helps protect the new materials during installation and allows our team to work safely and efficiently.
- [ ] Secure or remove wall hangings indoors — why: The vibration from roofing work can cause pictures, mirrors, and other items on interior walls to fall. It’s a good idea to take them down, especially on the top floor.
- [ ] Arrange for pet and child safety — why: The work site can be noisy and dusty, and there will be nails and debris. Keep children and pets away from the work area for their safety, perhaps arranging for them to stay with family or friends for the day.
- [ ] Plan for vehicle parking — why: Our crew will need space for their vehicles and materials. Make sure your driveway and street parking near your home are clear for our equipment.
- [ ] Protect sensitive items in your attic or garage — why: Though we're careful, dust and small debris can sometimes find their way into attic spaces or through cracks. Cover anything valuable or sensitive with tarps or sheets.
- [ ] Review your material choices and project plan — why: Double-check that you're clear on the specific materials, colors, and scope of work outlined in your agreement. Ask any last-minute questions before the work begins.

How to use this checklist: Go through each item a few days before your scheduled installation date. Ticking off these tasks will help ensure our team can focus on delivering a quality roof efficiently, minimizing any inconvenience to you and your family.

For any questions about preparing your home or to schedule your roof installation, reach out to Discounted Roofing Co. We're here to guide you every step of the way.
